cards.title: What each fix taught
cards.text: Every fix ends with its lesson here, named by its skill; its symptom and cause stay in the fixes table.

cards.title: Testing and shipping
cards.text: Skill 18, most of them: a check that sees what a visitor sees, a test that fails for the real cause.

cards.title: Safety and reliability
cards.text: Skills 15 and 14: fail closed, and an error that says what to do next.

cards.title: Measuring and seeing
cards.text: Skills 12, 13 and 17: a total true on every path, a replay key free of numbers.
